portraitGeneration.prompt: Create a square original natural history bestiary specimen portrait. Big Linda attachment is a style and flat parchment tone reference only. One albino giant octopus from The Waydown. An authentic octopus only, with a soft rounded mantle, eye on each side of the head, and exactly eight muscular tapering arms with clearly rendered underside suckers on several arms. No fins and no long specialized tentacles. Show the full animal obliquely from above, a few arms gracefully curled around rather than across the body, legible at 96 pixels. Skintone primarily ivory cream and soft warm off-white, slight muted blush on suctions and shadowed skin, subtle grayed shadows and natural dark eyes. Match Big Linda's painterly realism, restrained gouache brush detail, soft natural light. Plain matte neutral tan parchment with very fine even grain, neither orange nor golden, edge-to-edge without a horizon, scenery, water or any bubbles, props, vignette, hard cast shadow, text, frame, flare, fog, particles, or additional creatures. Center the octopus with clear ample margin around the complete arm silhouette so all eight tips fit a centered circular crop.

source.section: Chapter 5, The Town of Vallaki, N5 Arasek Stockyard
source.sourcePageKind: The publisher index identifies this chapter section. Its rules require book access.
source.sourceWitness: - 5th Edition (2014)/Adventures/Curse of
source.errataEvidence: Official Curse of Strahd errata v1.1 revises the p. 115 training target to Strahd’s Vistani servants and deletes the description of recognition by smell and clothing. No mechanical stat changes in this erratum.
source.habitatEvidence: Editorial search terms that reflect the encounter on pp. 115, 116, 123, 124.
source.appearanceEvidence: The creature description or equipment in the printed encounter, with details from the new portrait.
source.artworkNote: New plain matte tan parchment portrait using Big Linda as the style reference.
sourceNotes: The first printing replaces the base armor, HP, and challenge. It gives 84 HP without a replacement Hit Dice formula.
The printed base block gives +6 to hit and +5 damage on both attacks. The adventure does not change either value.

Publisher errata changes p. 115 to target Strahd’s Vistani servants and removes recognition by scent and clothing from that paragraph. Page 116 of the first printing describes broader targeting and is not separately amended in the errata.
